title: Basic health concepts: hydration
content: Hydration refers to having enough water available for normal body functions. Water needs vary with activity, environment, age, and health conditions. General educational information cannot determine an individual's needs; consult a qualified health professional for personal concerns.

title: Basic health concepts: sleep
content: Sleep is a recurring period of rest. Consistent routines and a comfortable sleep environment are commonly discussed as general sleep-hygiene practices. Persistent sleep problems can have many causes and should be discussed with a qualified health professional.

title: Basic health concepts: hand hygiene
content: Handwashing with soap and clean running water helps remove dirt and many germs from hands. Educational public-health guidance commonly recommends cleaning hands before eating and after using the toilet. Follow local public-health guidance for specific situations.
